biography:
As Senior Associate, Energy & Sustainability at Beale Infrastructure, Emily supports sourcing power supply and energy infrastructure for Beale’s data center development projects, while also leading the development and coordination of Beale’s sustainability strategy, focusing on carbon-free energy procurement. She works within Beale's Energy Team to engage with utilities, identify new generation assets, and analyze broader market developments. 

Emily has a Master's of Science in Environmental Economics and Climate Change from the London School of Economics and a Bachelors of Science in Economics and Bachelor of Arts in Environmental Studies from the University of Washington in Seattle.
